name: maui-devflow-inspector
description: MAUI DevFlow Inspector host for VS Code — embeds the existing DevFlow Web Inspector for a running .NET MAUI app.

chatParticipants.name: devflow
chatParticipants.description: Inspect and diagnose a running .NET MAUI app through the shared DevFlow Inspector.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Open the Inspector for an exact running MAUI app.

commands.name: diagnose-selection
commands.description: Explain Problems and layout findings for the selected live element.

commands.name: explain-problem
commands.description: Explain a current DevFlow runtime Problem.

commands.name: create-test
commands.description: Open the human-reviewed DevFlow Test Workbench.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_getSelectedElement
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the .NET MAUI UI element the user currently has selected in the MAUI DevFlow Inspector (its type, AutomationId, text, and whether XAML source is available). Call this whenever the user refers to 'the selected element', 'this element', 'the selected item', 'the highlighted control', or 'what I clicked', so you act on the exact control they mean.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_getDataSnapshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the bounded, redacted point-in-time Data snapshot the user added from the MAUI DevFlow Inspector (Logs, Network, Preferences, Device, Sensors, file metadata, or native Alerts). Use the included followUpTools identifiers to query DevFlow MCP for fresher or deeper detail when needed.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_openInspector
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open or focus the MAUI DevFlow Inspector for a running app. Use when the user explicitly asks to inspect the live app.

agent.description: Exact broker agent ID when known.

element.description: Optional current element ID to focus.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_resolveActiveApp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve the exact running MAUI app currently attached to the DevFlow Inspector, including its agent instance and platform.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_getProblems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return bounded current MAUI runtime Problems such as binding failures, optionally filtered to one live element.

languageModelTools.name: maui-devflow_getCurrentEvidence
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return only the bounded evidence preview, imported safe projection, flow-run reference, or Data snapshot the user explicitly displayed or attached.

mauiDevflow.brokerPort.description: Explicit DevFlow broker port. 0 = auto-discover via ~/.mauidevflow/broker.json.

enumDescriptions: Open beside the active editor when one is open, otherwise in the active editor group.
Always open in a new column beside the active editor.
Always open in the currently active editor group.
mauiDevflow.openLocation.description: Where to place the MAUI DevFlow Inspector panel when it opens.

mauiDevflow.publishDiagnostics.description: Preview: publish current DevFlow runtime Problems and explicit layout findings into VS Code Diagnostics.

scripts.package:vsix: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.js && vsce package --pre-release --no-dependencies --out dist/maui-devflow-inspector.vsix
